notes.title: Play the Updated Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu Demo
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 👋[/p][p]
Just a quick post to say that the demo for [b]Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu[/b] — the sequel to our debut title [i]Nippon Marathon[/i] — has been updated, and we’d love for you to give it a try! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]If you don’t know, [i]Nippon Marathon[/i] is a chaotic racer full of strange obstacles where you sprint, trip, and tumble your way across Japan. The updated demo gives you a taste of the madness still to come in the full game.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358880/Nippon_Marathon_2_Daijoubu/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"]We'd love to see what you think!
[/p][h1][b]🆕 What’s New in the Demo?[/b][/h1][h3][b]🏗️ Demo Stage YOLKO HARBOUR (Reworked!)[/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Inspired by Yokohama, this fishing port-themed stage has it all: water, giant carp, anchor-twirling sailors, and yes… a very grumpy Giant Octopus 🐙.[/p][list][*][p]We’ve reworked most of the stage to include extra dockside hazards and new environments. [/p][/*][*][p]Test your sea legs in the all-new cargo ship section, but watch out for Octopus attacks, the water’s about to get a little choppy.[/p][/*][*][p]Find alternate routes by jumping on dockside machinery like forklifts and scissorlifts. They might launch you to victory… or straight into the drink.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45350013/24cf1bb1cb9f78068d28db890be9baec46a9f06d.gif"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]📸 Photo Mode (✨NEW FEATURE✨)[/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Thought you didn’t need a photo mode in a silly party racer? Think again! Now you can pause mid-race and capture those relivable moments - whether that’s a dramatic tumble, a Shiba Inu ambush, or someone getting sent flying by a giant anchor.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]You can move the camera wherever you like, zoom in and out, and let the auto-focus do the work:[/p][list][*][p]Want to take a photo of Zenbei’s luscious eyelashes up close? Go for it. [/p][/*][*][p]Feel like waving and pretending to be one of the crowd? Absolutely. [/p][/*][*][p]Or maybe you just want to capture your wildest antics for clout - we don’t judge.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Here's some screenshots we took using Photo Mode:[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45350013/9febf895151afc5fd2fcb7c6aa24bacc321f52a0.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45350013/ecf64df97cf63ddeb0613bb685bca5167e4aac56.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45350013/98f35b41635b2b25b0a9bd51bade009691774b8d.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45350013/aa6d8f7b17af68fe7ca65e20da70fe4de84a42d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]And if you’re more of a sightseer than a stunt photographer, Photo Mode doubles as a [b]mini-tour guide[/b]: pan around, read the barrier text, snap your favourite shop signs (Google Translate at the ready) - trust us, they’re worth it.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]You can find Photo Mode in the pause menu.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]🕺 Strike a Pose on the Podium [/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]It didn’t feel very Nippon Marathon to just stand still on the podium while being told you’re the [b]smelliest contestant[/b]! [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]So each contestant now has their own [b]exhausted animation[/b]. But we didn’t stop there.  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Each contestant also comes with a [b]completely unique set of dance moves[/b] to show off while the scores are tallied. Mix and match to create chaotic podium performances and make the stage your personal spotlight! [/p][p align="start"](Currently, these animations are only available for player-controlled contestants; AI will get them in a future update.)[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45350013/b952b22bbc710cf25aa339512050cdbc20d1826e.gif"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Pssst… want to go completely wild and break free from the podium altogether?[/i] Enter the secret cheat code:[/p][p align="start"]
[b]up down up down left right left right up up down down up up down down[/b][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]What was once a bug is now a cheeky feature, you're welcome.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]👏Other Fun Updates:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The screen now shakes for melon & gas tank explosions making them feel even more dramatic💥[/p][/*][*][p]Watch out for sneaky finish line gates that love to trick you, some might be a fake![/p][/*][*][p]Our Create-A-Contestant got a makeover too — updated head and hairstyle models[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]For a full list of changes since the March Playtest; including bug fixes, performance improvements, and gameplay tweaks, check the [b]Patch Notes[/b] at the end of this post.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h1][b]🎮 Challenge Friends with Remote Play Together[/b][/h1][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The demo supports solo, local, and online multiplayer via Steam Remote Play Together![/p][p align="start"]It’s the perfect excuse to grab your friends and challenge them to a race, or even a [b]podium dance-off[/b], who really deserves the title of Nippon Marathon Champion![/p][p align="start"][/p][h1][b]📢 Try the New Demo Today![/b][/h1][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]This might only be one stage, but it gives you a taste of what’s to come in the full game, and a glimpse of just how dedicated we are to making Nippon Marathon 2 the ultimate racing game![/p][p align="start"][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358880/Nippon_Marathon_2_Daijoubu/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"]Want even more mayhem? Our[url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FSpsyEHs"] [u]Discord Playtest[/u][/url] will include these updates plus a brand-new stage — join the community for early access and be part of the fun.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]🔗 Join the Discord -> [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/SpsyEHs"]https://discord.gg/SpsyEHs[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Thanks for reading![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Stay Daijoubu,
[/b]Wedy Jones[/p][p align="start"][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]📝 FULL PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed pineapple rope line renderer glitch[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flag props spawning off-centre (causing them to fall over)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed commentary incorrectly saying spectators were blown up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed commentary talking about eliminated player’s stamina[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent player order bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial bug: wrong key assigned for Waving to the crowd[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial bug: instructions not progressing if paused[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚙️ Performance & Technical[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved loading times[/p][/*][*][p]Added upscaler options in Settings (⚠️ unstable on Steam Deck, under investigation)[/p][/*][*][p]Camera updates:[/p][list][*][p]Now follows centre point of all contestants when 4 players are active[/p][/*][*][p]Zooms further out when contestants are spread out[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]🎮 Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Dive skill improved – more useful & predictable[/p][/*][*][p]CPU AI: better navigation, more variety, smarter obstacle handling[/p][/*][*][p]Contestants respawn in random order at checkpoints[/p][/*][*][p]Updated character poses, hairstyles and head models in Create-A-Contestant[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon visibility improved:[/p][list][*][p]Larger & clearer in gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]More realistic in snapshots[/p][/*][*][p]Visible in contestant’s hands during snapshots[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Snapshot camera angles improved[/p][/*][*][p]Water splash animation upgraded with a new hand-drawn 9-frame spritesheet[/p][/*][*][p]Item respawn time reduced (2s → 1.5s)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased cucumber attack range slightly[/p][/*][*][p]Contestants recover from falls quicker & more reliably[/p][/*][*][p]Water slows contestants less than before[/p][/*][*][p]Banana improved: instantly trips enemies, especially when close behind[/p][/*][*][p]Explosion interaction: pineapple bursts when hit (⚠️ not fully working yet)[/p][/*][*][p]Elimination rules tweaked:[/p][list][*][p]Must sweat for at least 2s before elimination[/p][/*][*][p]Immediate elimination if 15m+ behind 1st place[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: One Button, 56 Mini-Games—SUPER 56 Brings the Chaos to Couch Co-op Fest!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Steam’s Couch Co-op Fest is live for one week, and we’re thrilled to announce that SUPER 56 is part of the fun!

If you haven’t played [b]SUPER 56[/b] yet, here’s what your missing out on:

[list]
[*] 56 genre-bending mini-games controlled with just ONE BUTTON.
[*] Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores.
[*] Packed with gaming nostalgia, hilarious references, and all the charm (and WTF moments) of Wario-Ware.
[*] Perfect for your Steam Deck—take the madness on the go!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/d86a6c8a9941ef14c0ad1188d98b61a49aeaf3a5.gif[/img]

[h2]More Players, More Madness![/h2]

Originally a single-player experience, we heard your feedback loud and clear—so we added multiplayer mode! Now, you can gather up to 8 players on one couch (hopefully, it’s a big one) and battle it out for SUPER 56 champion status. Will you top the leaderboard, or will you be the one crying in the corner? 😂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/8a98a5ede695acbb5ad49a9ef88aed6f2c29cee9.gif[/img]

[h2]Gamepads? Where We’re Going, We Don’t Need Gamepads![/h2]

Try MIC MODE and control the game with SOUND! Warm up your vocal cords, grab a frying pan, or just scream your way through 56 mini-games. It’s hilarious, chaotic, and guaranteed to annoy your neighbours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/3346fe81476fe9e46ffb24c2ebe2b2fad80abc15.gif[/img]

[h2]The Sounds of SUPER 56—Anytime, Anywhere![/h2]

Can’t get enough of the SUPER 56 vibes? The official soundtrack is available now! Stream it on [url=https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwvj9iWDi02_N7VP_5OKFTRJNU-4wFIY_]YouTube[/url], [url=https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6Aq42iQ3ZDgj7k29TosKA7?si=d1818fb822cd4b1b&nd=1&dlsi=a21b2425a4644b5e]Spotify[/url], and [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/super-56/1721942499]Apple Music[/url], or grab the OST from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2603160/SUPER_56_Soundtrack/]Steam [/url]and relive the madness anytime.

[h2]Buy SUPER 56 on Steam now[/h2]

So what are you waiting for? Spread the chaos and challenge your friends to a game of SUPER 56 today!

👉[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659150/SUPER_56/] Buy SUPER 56 on Steam now[/url] 👈

notes.title: Wishlist Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Get ready to duck, dodge, and dive into chaos because Nippon Marathon 2 is sprinting onto Steam Early Access in Q2 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/f198e8168256c358fbd813d04819ee240d2084ae.png[/img]

[h2]What's Nippon Marathon?[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/746940/Nippon_Marathon/]Nippon Marathon[/url]  was our first game—a wacky, physics-driven party racer where up to four players sprint, stumble, and soar through Japan’s wildest courses. Think Micro Machines meets the bonkers energy of Takeshi's Castle! 

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
This sequel is bigger, crazier, and packed with even more ridiculous fun:
✨ Vastly improved graphics
✨ Brand-new marathons filled with hazards and surprises
✨ A Create-a-Contestant feature
✨ All the wild Japanese TV energy you love

And if you’re wondering what Daijoubu means—it’s Japanese for “It’s fine!” or “Everything’s under control!”... though trust us, it won’t feel like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/4df61a58289e4f6a2e0dee48974a683b1d008394.gif[/img]

[h2]💾 Wishlist now and get ready for the madness![/h2]
We cannot wait to show you more over the next few months, so for now please Wishlist Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu on Steam today

If you liked the OG Nippon Marathon and the weirdness of SUPER 56, we think you'll definitely like the sequel.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358880]👉 Wishlist on Steam 👈[/url]

[h2]So why Early Access?[/h2]

With Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu, we’re taking a giant leap forward. Every aspect of the game has been rebuilt from the ground up, featuring improved gameplay, greatly enhanced visuals, all new hand-crafted stages and painstakingly detailed characters. Early Access provides an opportunity for us to collaborate with you, our community. Your input via Discord and the Steam Community Forums will be key to making Nippon Marathon 2 the best it can be. We will also be introducing an online mode, which we intend to develop alongside your continued feedback.

We cannot wait to show you more over the next few months, so for now please Wishlist Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu on Steam today

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358880/Nippon_Marathon_2_Daijoubu/]👉 Wishlist on Steam 👈[/url]

Let’s make this the most ridiculous marathon yet! 🦞🐕

Thanks everyone!

Amy & Andy
Onion Soup Interactive

notes.title: SUPER 56 V1.26 RELEASED!
notes.content:
SUPER 56 V1.26 Patch Notes

Hey everyone! We have a pretty nice update today, lots of fixes and improvements. Multiplayer is avalable on the beta branch and will be coming to the main branch in the next update (we're just waiting on localisation). Anyway, here's the notes!

-IMPORTANT! Fixed a bug in the CLEAN THE HOUSE TRIAL where the misc category was not being counted meaning you could score a much faster time by ignoring the 
outside areas... sorry to everyone that we've had to reset the leaderboard to ensure fairness
-Added a Fast Forward feature to the results screen in a normal run, hold A to fast forward
-Fixed a bug in GET 5 GOOD PHOTOS where the points were awarded even for a bad photo
-Improved DOCK THE SHIP to make it more interesting and more challenging
-Fixed an achievement bug for I don't Want to be Human!
-Fixed an achievement bug for Meaty Chunks in Gravy
-Made space for the upcoming Party Multiplayer mode which should be available within a week (available on beta branch now)
-Fixed the GLYPHS (level cap) so that loot boxes and hearts appear on the XP bar
-Improved Dolphin Stage (REACH THE FINISH LINE) logic, speed and difficulty, it's a better stage now!
-Improved some graphics on the BOUNCE 15 (skipping stones) stage
-PRESENT EVIDENCE now greys out used evidence
-in KEEP BABY ALIVE changed temperature and food/drink info from text based to icon based for quicker and easier readability
-Made the fish in CATCH 3 RIVERMEN faster and made the particle effect when they bite more recognisable
-GO THRU CHECKPOINTS, now the checkpoints actually look like checkpoints
-added bunnies to SMASH THE CAR, don't hit them or you'll lose your multiplier!
-Fixed a few spots in PREPARE TO SUCK where you could drop through the scenery
-added loading dots to the leaderboards so you can tell something's happening 

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Get Your Jingle On in the Steam Winter Sale
notes.content:
Hello humans

Hope you're full of holiday cheer, now that the Steam Winter Sale is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/3fda113021613872ccc27dbb661c5ea28c213019.gif[/img]

We're spreading the [strike]joy[/strike] chaos with a 10% discount in the Steam Winter Sale. We know that the holidays are typically all about family, friends, and food, but the holidays are also about [i]gaming[/i]. 

Now a fast paced mini game collection may not be your typical choice for a holiday game, but we guarantee it'll be a great addition to your party game collection, and will leave Grandma asking [i]just what was in the gravy[/i].

We recently added some free content too, so here's a reminder of what was added:

[h2]Mic Control (Experimental)[/h2]
[previewyoutube=EAhPmjWxjYM;full][/previewyoutube]
Ever dreamt of yelling at your game and having it actually listen? Now's your chance! Mic Control lets you boss around SUPER 56 using your microphone – it's like having your own gaming genie. Grab a head-set style mic, maybe a Santa hat too, and let the mayhem commence. 

[h2]Trial Mode - Clean the Whole House:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/de85e44a9feec6af5daff5ab635c7d4756d5cbf4.gif[/img]
Feeling the festive cleaning spirit? Try out the first Trial Mode – Clean the Whole House! Grab the cat-vacuum, channel your inner Mrs. Claus, and compete for cleaning glory. Each trial comes with its own leaderboard, turning tidying up into a festive competition. You might even discover the joy of cleaning... or not.

[h2]New Achievements, Secrets, and Surprises:[/h2]
Unwrap two shiny new achievements tied to the Clean the House Trial. One's a secret – because who doesn't love a bit of mystery during the holidays? Check out the Achievements table to see what challenges await and flex your gaming muscles.

[h2]Leaderboard Shenanigans:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e5fb9e561af3567f53bfc4914a76c4834821ce09.jpg[/img]
Laugh your way through the leaderboards as everyone's witty remarks make an appearance. We admit we spend too much time reading these gems, but it's the holidays – time for some good-natured chuckles!

[h2]Miscellaneous Awesomeness:[/h2]
We've sprinkled in some UI magic and fixed up Simplified Chinese credits. Oh, and about our dear Reiwa man – he's taking a festive break and sent his doppelgänger to keep you company. Is it him? Is it not? The mystery thickens like eggnog.

So, what are you waiting for? Grab your controller, keyboard, drum kit, dog food, doorbell, or mouth, boot up SUPER 56, and make this holiday season the weirdest one yet. May your victories be sweet, your fails be hilarious, and your neighbours forgiving. 

Happy holidays and get playing SUPER 56!

notes.title: SUPER 56 V1.22: SUPER NEW CONTENT UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hey HUMANS! It's time to check out the new features in our latest SUPER 56 update which is available now:

[h1]Mic Control (experimental)[/h1]

[previewyoutube=EAhPmjWxjYM;full][/previewyoutube]

Now you can control the whole game using your microphone input, we find this works best with a head-set style mic so that other sounds don't interfere with your game. We had a real fun time playing SUPER 56 using guitars, dog toys and other random items, it's a total blast!

[h1]Trial Mode - Clean the Whole House[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/de85e44a9feec6af5daff5ab635c7d4756d5cbf4.gif[/img]

We've added the first Trial to the game, in this trial you need to clean the whole house using the cat-vacuum. Each new trial we add will come with its own leaderboard too so please look forward to them. Yeah!

[h1]New Achievements[/h1]

There are two new achievements, both are unlocked via the new Clean the House Trial. One is secret and the other can be unlocked by completing the trial in under 4 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e5fb9e561af3567f53bfc4914a76c4834821ce09.jpg[/img]

There is also a new Achievements table, so you can see the full list of achievements you've unlocked, and need to unlock

[h1]Leaderboard Changes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/db7f0e42a22f2f690ddadd0d68386cd6318b2a9d.jpg[/img]
You'll now see everyone's amusing phrases on their leaderboard entries, I spend too much time looking at these.

[h1]Misc[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/e67f78807dd010ac846015e305202d695e63ebaa.jpg[/img]

Various UI and localisation improvements (including fixing the Simplified Chinese credits).
We've also replaced the image of our dear Reiwa man with a delightful 3D model of someone who looks scarily similar, but is.definitely.not.him.... ok?


[h1]Future Development:[/h1]

We're currently splitting our time between adding new content and preparing the game for Nintendo Switch porting. We really hope that SUPER 56 will gain some much needed visibility by being available on Switch and if that is the case it will enable us to bring even more updates to the Steam version.

Thanks again for your continued support!

Andy & Amy

notes.title: Super 56 is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Super 56 is now available on Steam with 10% launch discount for one week! 

We invite you on a chaotic joyride through 56 genre-bending mini-games. Find love in a lavish-yet-micro JRPG, drift around an arid desert racetrack, and so much more all with the press of a single button.

[previewyoutube=omGJDKGWeQQ;full][/previewyoutube]

SUPER 56 features 56 genre-bending mini-games to overcome, all designed around the ‘A’ button. Players have a finite amount of lives to complete as many mini-game stages as possible in a single run. Each stage draws inspiration from a different era of gaming and even includes some recognizable references and homages to gaming history. Whether it’s mashing to recover a tennis ball hit into the net, holding to line up the perfect putt, or tapping to shoot down demons in a familiar-looking retro FPS, you never know what to expect next!

As you successfully progress through runs, the mini-games speed up and the pandemonium increases! Keep up with the pace long enough, and you’ll secure the ultimate bragging rights as you sit atop the worldwide leaderboards. Stand out on the leaderboards with unlockable characters, voice packs, and outlandish phrases. Even after you become a SUPER 56 legend, keep the experience fresh through Daily Challenges, as well as applicable Mod Stones to alter the rules of play.

Mash, hold, and tap your way through SUPER 56!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/7d14441c772729eefe8d25c5d53f5027267cd9c8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 56 genre-bending mini-games, all designed around the press of a single button.
[*] Easy to learn, yet hard to master gameplay.
[*] Unlockable Mod Stones to change the rules of each playthrough.
[*] References, homages, and ridiculous humor centered around gaming history.
[*] Compete on the worldwide leaderboard and earn the ultimate bragging rights.
[*] Fully customizable experience with unlockable characters, voice packs, ludicrous phrases, and more.
[*] Achievements galore! 
[/list]

notes.title: SUPER 56 - Launch update and beta testing
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have some great news, we've agreed a deal with a publisher to bring SUPER 56 to Steam (and other platforms a little afterwards).

Our publisher will bring more languages support for SUPER 56, including German, Chinese, Japanese, and so forth.

While we initially viewed that the game should release into Early Access very soon we have come to an agreement that SUPER 56 will instead launch fully, this means that the full game will be completed sooner than expected but also that the imminent release of an Early Access version will not.

It's a tough decision to make because we know that a lot of people were looking forward to playing the Early Access version real soon and we feel we've already caused trouble for some people by pushing this release date back once before.

[b]So to make up for this we will be opening up another round of beta testing[/b] soon, this will also help us stress test the back-end services (which was why we chose Early Access in the first place).

We will post a Steam Announcement once registration for the beta test becomes available but if you want to get ahead of that and pre-register your interest please join our Discord and let us know and we'll make sure you're at the front of the queue!

Many thanks

Andy and Amy

notes.title: SUPER 56 demo now available in SteamNextFest
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick announcement to say that upcoming mini-game collection SUPER 56 is now available to play during the Steam Next Fest.

[previewyoutube=kkuOSTMt5n4;full][/previewyoutube]

The aim of SUPER 56 is to get the best score possible by completing each stage as fast as you can. Sounds easy, right? Think again...

Play 10 of the craziest stages as fast as you can, try not to die, and get your best score on the global leaderboard on SUPER 56.

Amy & Andy
(Onion Soup Interactive)

notes.title: This hilarious game is made of 56 frantic minigames that you only need a single button to play
notes.content: The Atari 2600 controller was about the simplest game controller you could imagine. No triggers, no D-Pad, no shoulder buttons, no haptic feedback or rumble pak. It consisted of just a joystick and a single red button you mashed with your thumb... Read more.

notes.title: SUPER 56 Demo available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're SUPER excited to announce that SUPER 56 will be available via Steam Early Access 20th February 2023 and you can [b]download the demo right now.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/560bb60ceb009b7d16fcbaab40a37488f3d79569.png[/img]

The demo will feature 10 stages from the main game, each very different from the next, to give you a true taste of the eclectic gaming compilation which is SUPER 56. Believe me when I say choosing just 10 was difficult, if we had our way the demo would include all 56 stages (but that wouldn't be much of a demo would it?). The level progression is capped, but you'll still feel the warm and fuzzy feeling in your gut as you rank up and get introduced to (in fun cutscene style) the rivalry between BRONES, KRONOS and their annoying neighbour, JOHN ZOMBIE. Things will get SUPER NASTY! 

We'd love you to download the demo and share your thoughts, as any feedback will be vital for development as we head into early access on 20th February. We chose early access as we need your help to test network functionality, as this will be the first game we have developed which has Playfab integrated into the game.

Plus we'd love your feedback on what stages should be included into the main game.

So if you like what you hear, please download the demo of SUPER 56 and we hope you enjoy the slice of what's to come from the Early Access and full game!

Thanks

Amy & Andy

notes.title: Please Welcome SUPER 56 Into the Ring
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you may have noticed, Press A For Achievements, has a new name. 

We thought long and hard about this, and decided that a name change was necessary and better for the game. 

We didn't want to be associated with trophy grabs (no shade), and wanted a name that truly represented our game.

So, welcome [b]SUPER 56[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158863/468503915102cdde67c4884d85ce01e4371424a5.png[/img]

The premise of the game is the same as before, a 56 mini-game collection which challenges players to get through as many stages as possible using a single controller button.  Gameplay increases in intensity as the player passes each stage and players gain coins and XP. Earn mod-stones to mix up gameplay and make your next playthrough a little bit more challenging, easier, or rewarding!  

you can watch the brand new trailer here, you may recognise some ol' favourites, as well as some new ones...

[previewyoutube=kkuOSTMt5n4;full][/previewyoutube]

We're hoping to release SUPER 56 early next year, so stay tuned for more updates as the release date gets closer.

Please let us know your thoughts!

Amy & Andy
